watches.name: Aryon Nature Automatic Noir - Black Obsidian Stone
watches.description: A fragment of the Earth on your wrist. The dial of the Nature Obsidian is a fine sheet of black obsidian — volcanic glass, born from lava cooled in a single instant. Cut and polished by hand, it is a black that is deep, dense and alive, crossed by subtle shifts of sheen and texture that no pigment can reproduce. One stone. One movement. No compromise. Dial cut from a single sheet of natural black obsidian 40mm 316L surgical-grade stainless steel case Sapphire front crystal Miyota 8315 automatic movement · ~60h power reserve Mineral-glass exhibition caseback 5 ATM / 50m water resistance Individual serial number engraved on the caseback No two are ever alike Because every dial is cut from a different section of the stone, no two Nature watches share the same dial. The depth of the black, the play of sheen, the faint texture left by the lava — all of it is unrepeatable. This is the trait most prized by collectors: a piece that exists once and will never exist again. The beauty is not manufactured. It is revealed. Yours is one of one. The mechanical heart Inside beats the Miyota 8315, built by Citizen Watch Co. It winds itself through the natural motion of the wrist and can also be wound by hand, accumulating around 60 hours of power reserve — it keeps running for two and a half days off the wrist. It runs at 21,600 vph (3 Hz) on 21 jewels, with stop-seconds for precise time-setting. Miyota has since discontinued this calibre, which makes each Nature quietly more exclusive with time. The mineral-glass exhibition caseback turns the reverse of the watch into a second showcase, with the movement and your individual serial number in full view. Built to be kept The 40mm case is machined from 316L surgical-grade stainless steel. A sapphire crystal protects the dial; the solid 316L bracelet closes with a 316L butterfly clasp. Five atmospheres of water resistance. The clean dial carries no numerals — only the engraved triangular Aryon logo and a discreet date window. Every piece is individually inspected before it leaves us. Tradition. Without compromise. Free worldwide shipping 24-month warranty Numbered piece · individually inspected before shipping

watches.name: Aryon Waves Summer Automatic Raspberry
watches.description: The dial as sculpture. The Waves collection draws from the avant-garde watch design movement of the 1970s and brings it into the 21st century: a three-dimensional dial with a liquid wave relief, an automatic movement visible through the sapphire caseback, and four editions with their own distinct identity. The octagonal 316L stainless steel case, with its sharp angular cuts and combined brushed-polished finish, frames the dial without competing with it. Geometry in service of the dial. A surface in motion The dial of the Waves collection is a three-dimensional relief with a liquid wave pattern that shifts with every change of light. In the morning, under natural light, the crests cast shadows entirely different from those of the evening. A white lacquered subdial at the 7 o’clock position houses the small seconds, floating above the main relief. The triangular Aryon logo, engraved at 12 o’clock, is the sole brand mark on the dial — discreet, but unmistakable. Waves Raspberry: Intensity without explanation. The deep raspberry dial, with its sculpted waves, turns every appearance into a statement of style that needs no words. Technical specifications Movement Automatic Hangzhou 7010A Power reserve ≥ 70 hours Frequency 28,800 A/h Jewels 24 Functions Hours · Minutes · Small seconds Case 316L stainless steel · octagonal Diameter / thickness 42mm (crown included) / 11mm Front crystal Sapphire with anti-reflective coating Caseback crystal High-hardness mineral — transparent Water resistance 100 metres Strap Cowhide leather · independent central metal anchor

watches.name: Aryon Minimal Automatic Green - Limited Edition
watches.description: Limited to 50 pieces per dial colour Individually numbered FREE SHIPPING Before a Minimal dial becomes a watch, ten decisions are made. Each dial is finished in synthetic enamel by BERLAC, a prestigious Swiss house specialising in watch enamels. Once the dial is finished, the enamel is spray-gun applied, in up to ten fine layers until the whole dial is covered. The final finish is set in an oven at 140°C. It sits under a pair of polished dauphine hands — the pointed, faceted style watchmakers preferred long before batons and arrows became the standard — chosen here because an enamelled dial deserves hands that reflect the light the same way the surface does. This is also the only line we make as a limited edition: fifty pieces in Blue, fifty in Green. Each with its own serial number, and none reissued once sold out. This Limited Edition isn’t closed — we plan to produce further ARYON MINIMAL shades, never repeating the first ones, fifty pieces per dial colour. The first ones flew out of our hands. Join our newsletter to hear about the next release.
